items.definition:
lubricant
Don't forget to add some lube to the chain.

one thousandth of a meter
The screw was only a few millimeters long.

a thin, crisp biscuit or cake
She enjoyed a chocolate wafer with her coffee.

a person from Bangladesh
Many Bangladeshis live in London.

a person employed to prevent trouble or to refuse admission at the door of a nightclub or bar
The bouncer checked IDs at the entrance.

a person from California
Many Californians enjoy surfing.

a woodwind instrument
She learned to play the clarinet in school.

the art or practice of cooking
She enrolled in a cookery class.

a thick, soft substance
She applied a rich face creme before bed.

a support for walking
After the accident, she had to use crutches.

a large room containing many beds
Students live in the university dormitory.

the quality of being fresh
The freshness of the bread was delightful.

a piece of printed information given free to students or other people
The teacher distributed a handout with the key points.

a drug or medicine for relieving pain
She took a painkiller to ease her headache.

Water from the sea or ocean.
Seawater is too salty to drink.

A young plant, especially one raised from seed.
We planted the tomato seedlings in the garden.

a small branch or division of a branch
The bird landed on a thin twig.

a large, shaggy-haired wild ox
Yaks are native to the Himalayas.

A woman or girl who attends a bride at her wedding
My sister asked me to be her bridesmaid.

A celebrity
The restaurant was full of celebs last night.

An aromatic herb with feathery leaves
She garnished the salmon with fresh dill.

A sensation of spinning and a tendency to lose one's balance
She complained of dizziness and nausea after the ride.

grandchild (informal)
My grandkids are coming to visit next weekend.

a team sport played with a ball
She plays handball every Tuesday evening.

A flowering shrub or a pale purple color
The garden was filled with the sweet scent of lilac.

The period around the summer solstice
Midsummer is often celebrated with festivals and bonfires.

A unit of mass equal to one thousandth of a gram
The tablet contains 500 milligrams of active ingredient.

The onset of night; dusk
We waited until nightfall before starting our journey.

a synthetic fabric
This shirt is made of 100% polyester.

a small dog breed with a short snout and wrinkled face
My neighbor has a cute little pug named Daisy.

a person who rows a boat
The rower trained hard for the competition.

a tube or lip through which liquid can be poured or discharged
Water flowed from the teapot's spout.

a man's dinner jacket
He looked very smart in his new tuxedo.

a recording of a book being read aloud
She listens to an audiobook during her daily commute.

a female ballet dancer
The young ballerina dreamed of performing on a big stage.

an optical instrument with a lens for each eye, used for viewing distant objects
We used binoculars to watch the birds in the distance.

a person or thing that checks; a piece used in the game of checkers
The quality checker inspected every item before it left the factory.

an apartment building where each apartment is individually owned
They bought a new condominium overlooking the city.

the state of being crazy or insane
The sheer craziness of the situation made everyone laugh.

a line or block of text appearing at the bottom of each page of a book or document
The page number was placed in the footer of the document.

an event or occurrence
The concert was a big happening in the city.

a person with the ability to influence potential buyers of a product or service by promoting or recommending the items on social media
The social media influencer promoted the new skincare line.

a lively dance
They danced a lively Irish jig.

the area next to a lake
We enjoyed a picnic by the lakeside.

a person or machine that loads
The front-end loader moved the dirt.

a piece of jewelry or a medal
She wore a beautiful gold medallion around her neck.

either of two external openings of the nose
Smoke came out of his nostrils.

an activity done for enjoyment; a hobby
Reading is my favorite pastime.

A container for plants.
She bought a new ceramic planter for her basil plant.

A chess piece, or a type of crow.
In chess, the rook moves horizontally or vertically.

A collection of samples.
The bakery offered a sampler of their best cookies.

A vehicle or piece of furniture with a specified number of seats.
We rented a seven-seater car for our family trip.

A small North American mammal that can spray a foul-smelling liquid.
A skunk sprayed its strong odor near our campsite.

a very successful fashion model
She dreamed of becoming a famous supermodel.

a device that regulates temperature
Please adjust the thermostat to 20 degrees Celsius.

a person who plays the violin
The talented violinist played a beautiful solo.

a musical instrument with a keyboard and bellows
He learned to play the accordion at a young age.

a person or thing that beats, especially a kitchen utensil for beating food
She used an electric beater to mix the cake batter.

the state or period of being a boy
He spent his boyhood playing in the fields.

a metal box or cylinder, typically for food or chemicals
She stored her coffee beans in an airtight canister.

a speech sound that is not a vowel
The English alphabet has 21 consonants.

a sudden cry or remark, especially expressing surprise, anger, or pain
Her exclamation of joy filled the room.

a major road for fast-moving traffic
We took the expressway to avoid city traffic.

a large entrance or reception room or area
We waited for them in the hotel foyer.
